name: com.lingkyn.scene-flow.core
description: Engine-light scene flow substrate: stable scene set and scene identity with a canonical form, an immutable declared scene graph with one active scene per set and one fallback set, typed non-negative transition durations, load/unload/switch intents on an immutable flow state advanced through a transition state machine by explicit elapsed-time, load-completed, and load-failed intents only, fail-closed error recovery to the declared fallback set, deterministic replay with a fingerprint, and structured results with stable failure codes.

samples.description: Domain-only scene graph, transition options, a full load/switch/unload cycle driven by explicit intents, one failed load recovering to the fallback set, and a replayed intent sequence; needs no scene.
